name: Structure attended to before more is built on it
principle: Look at the structure proactively, with few tokens, and say where it needs attention before the next work is built on it; leave it alone when it is fine.
state_description: The few structural flaws that matter are named while recent and planned work can still change course, nothing is raised twice unless worse, and what a person owns is only ever proposed.
hints_of_measurement: Planted problems raised and clean structures silent over scripted structures, and the tokens used against the caps.
